findings.msg: the hero has no button (the nav's does not count)
findings.fix: add the action: a button in the hero, one on every priced item, one in the closing section

findings.msg: the page has no visible h1
findings.fix: put the category noun in the h1 (and who it is for, or where), in 2 to 8 words

findings.msg: the first screen holds no number, price, date, place, platform or genre
findings.fix: put one hard fact from the brief on the first screen: a number, a price, a date, the place, the platforms it runs on or a game's genre; take it from the brief or remove the claim

findings.msg: <html> has no lang: a screen reader guesses the language and hyphenation is off
findings.fix: set <html lang> to the language the page is written in, from the brief ("de" for a German page)

findings.msg: the page has no <title>: the tab, the bookmark and the search result show its address
findings.fix: write a <title> "Name: what it is for whom or where" and a one-sentence description in other words (starter.html)

findings.fix: name the thing in every heading: the product, a part, the place or a section noun

findings.msg: the page has no visible h1
findings.fix: size headings by level: the h1 largest, one size per level, each level below the one above

findings.msg: a software page (--type) deals no moment: every kind carries one, two on a long page (moments.md)
findings.fix: deal one (moments.mjs pick --page software) and mount it in its own section

findings.msg: no <meta name="description">: a search result and a shared link show a scrap of the page instead

findings.msg: the head lacks og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card, an icon, theme-color: a shared link shows no picture or title of its own

findings.msg: the hero ends at 908px on a 900px screen, 8px below the fold: it ends at the fold, 1px either way (SR-1)

findings.fix: make every section above it exactly one or two screens tall, so this one starts on a whole screen

findings.fix: give each section one h2, first in its .wrap, and the hero only its h1

findings.fix: use one container on every section and the nav (.wrap): one margin left and right, 64-120px on a desktop, 16-24px on a phone
